description: Creates a reusable set of inbound and outbound rules. Without rules it starts with SSH (TCP 22) and ping open from anywhere; pass rules: [] for none. Nothing is filtered until it is attached to a machine. Scope: network.write.

name.description: Display name of the firewall, 1 to 64 characters.

private_network.description: Also filter inbound traffic arriving through private networks (VPC, site-to-site VPN). Default false: private networks stay fully open.

rules.description: The firewall's full list of rules in order, up to 50. The first rule that matches decides; inbound, what no rule allows is refused.

action.description: allow (default) or deny. Rules are read in order and the first match wins: put a deny above the allow it overrides.

description.description: Free note shown next to the rule, e.g. "SSH from the office".

destinations.description: Outbound rules only: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges allowed out to. Omitted or empty: anywhere.

direction.description: in (default) for inbound traffic, out for outbound. The first enabled outbound allow rule makes outbound restrictive.

enabled.description: false keeps the rule without applying it (temporary rules, tests). Default true.

ports.description: TCP/UDP only: "22", "80,443" or a range "8000-8100" (up to 15 items). Omitted or null: all ports.

protocol.description: icmp covers ping for IPv4 and IPv6; any is every protocol.

sources.description: Inbound rules only: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges allowed in. Omitted or empty: anywhere.

name: create_firewall
title: Create a firewall
